links.outcome: Nursing students' AI knowledge level and willingness to take AI training
links.effect: 98% of students had low AI knowledge, 1.8% average, 0.15% high; 85.5% were willing to take AI training.
links.quote: Findings revealed that 98 % of students had low AI knowledge, with only 1.8 % demonstrating average knowledge and 0.15 % showing high knowledge.

unlisted_practices: Integrating AI education into nursing curricula
Improving infrastructure to support AI implementation in healthcare

screen.reason: Survey assessing Nigerian nursing students' knowledge, perceptions, and readiness for AI integration in healthcare.
